role: Base class for GL texture objects: lazily generates the GL texture id and deletes it on release.
scope_reason: GL texture-object plumbing: the native engine loads PNG bytes straight into memory (csrc/engine/pngread.c, raster_mobs.c read_texture/ensure_assets, raster_entities.c live_entity_tex) and keeps no GL texture ids, so this lifecycle has nothing to mirror.
notes: The texture content the pixel gates need is ported (the atlas and mob PNGs); only the GL id lifecycle is not, by design.
